articles.title: Thousands of Gig Workers Are Quietly Teaching the World's Robots to Do Household Chores
articles.summary: Behind every helpful robot, there are thousands of real people doing the teaching. Across the world, gig workers — people hired for short-term jobs — are being paid to perform everyday household tasks like folding laundry and washing dishes so that robots can observe and learn. The robotics industry needs huge amounts of real-life movement data to train machines to act in homes. Workers are recorded completing these chores, and that footage becomes training material for robot AI systems. Experts say demand for this kind of human-generated data is growing fast, raising important new questions about fair wages, working conditions, and the future relationship between humans and intelligent machines.

lv1: What kind of everyday jobs are gig workers doing to help train robots? (零工工人正在做哪些日常工作來幫助訓練機械人？)
Why do robots need to watch humans before they can learn to do tasks themselves? (為什麼機械人在學會自己完成任務之前需要觀察人類？)
lv2: Why do you think companies use human workers to collect movement data instead of programming robots directly? (你認為為什麼公司使用人類工人收集動作數據，而不是直接為機械人編程？)
How might filming people doing housework raise concerns about privacy? (拍攝人們做家務可能會引起哪些關於私隱的憂慮？)
lv3: If robots eventually replace humans in household and care jobs, what are the possible benefits and harms for society — especially for low-income workers? (如果機械人最終取代人類從事家務和護理工作，對社會尤其是低收入工人有什麼潛在好處和壞處？)

Should gig workers who generate AI training data receive special legal protections or profit-sharing from the companies that use their work? Present arguments for and against. (為人工智能提供訓練數據的零工工人，是否應獲得特別法律保護或利潤分享？請列出正反論點。)

articles.title: Chennai Fishing Families Battle Daily to Survive as the Sea Grows More Dangerous
articles.summary: In the southern Indian city of Chennai, fishing communities living in some of the poorest neighbourhoods face a daily fight for survival. These families have built their entire way of life around the sea, depending on it for both food and income. However, shifting ocean conditions and unpredictable weather are making fishing increasingly difficult and hazardous each season. Their situation highlights a much bigger challenge facing coastal communities throughout Asia, where traditional livelihoods are under enormous pressure from environmental change. Many families are being forced to rethink how they live and work, raising urgent questions about who is responsible for protecting vulnerable communities from the effects of a changing environment.

lv1: Where do the fishing families in this story live? (故事中的漁民家庭住在哪裡？)
What makes the work of fishermen in Chennai harder and more dangerous each year? (是什麼讓金奈漁民的工作每年變得越來越困難和危險？)
lv2: Why might poorer fishing communities suffer more from environmental changes than wealthier communities that have other job options? (為什麼較貧窮的漁業社區比有其他就業選擇的富裕社區更受環境變化影響？)
How could changes in the ocean affect not only fishermen, but also the food supply for people living in nearby cities? (海洋的變化除了影響漁民，還會如何影響附近城市居民的食物供應？)
lv3: Who should bear the greatest responsibility for helping coastal communities adapt to environmental change — local governments, national governments, or wealthier industrialised countries that produce more pollution? Justify your answer. (誰應負最大責任幫助沿海社區適應環境變化——地方政府、中央政府，還是製造更多污染的富裕工業化國家？請說明你的立場。)

Some people argue that traditional fishing communities must modernise and find new jobs, while others insist their culture and way of life must be preserved. Which view is more convincing to you, and why? (有人認為傳統漁業社區必須現代化並尋找新工作，另一些人則堅持其文化和生活方式應受保護。哪種觀點對你更具說服力？為什麼？)

articles.title: 香港首任特首董建華喪禮今日舉行　政商各界送別歷史人物
articles.summary: 香港首任行政長官董建華本月初辭世，其喪禮於今日（21日）在北角香港殯儀館舉行。來自政界、商界及社會各界的人士到場，向這位見證香港回歸後重要歲月的領導人作最後道別。董建華生前亦擔任全國政協副主席要職，在香港近代歷史上地位舉足輕重。政府於附近的北角政府合署設置臨時公眾悼念區，讓普通市民亦可表達哀思。是次喪禮令社會各界反思香港走過的路，以及未來應如何繼續向前發展。

lv1: 董建華曾擔任什麼重要職位？
今日喪禮在香港什麼地方舉行？
lv2: 為什麼董建華對香港近代歷史具有特別重要的意義？
政府在附近設立公眾悼念區，反映了什麼社會價值觀？
lv3: 一個地方首任領導人的離世，可能對當地市民的身份認同和集體記憶產生什麼影響？請舉例說明。
評價歷史領導人的功過時，應以哪些標準作為依據？為什麼不同的人對同一位領導人可能有截然不同的評價？

articles.title: 名古屋亞運昨揭幕　港隊運動員全力出戰爭取佳績
articles.summary: 第二十屆亞洲運動會昨日（20日）在日本名古屋正式開幕，是相隔逾三十年後重返日本舉行的亞運盛事。日本天皇德仁與皇后雅子親臨主禮，典禮氣氛莊重而熱烈。香港代表團派出多名運動員出賽，當中體操項目的選手備受注目，誓為香港奪取榮譽。雖然開幕式部分座位有所空缺，但現場觀眾來自亞洲各地，氣氛依然熱鬧。香港多間商場同步直播開幕典禮，讓市民在社區中一同為港隊打氣，展現市民對本港運動員的熱烈支持。

lv1: 今屆亞運會在哪個日本城市舉行？
香港哪些項目的運動員參加了今屆亞運？
lv2: 亞運會對亞洲各地運動員和市民有什麼重要意義？
商場直播亞運開幕禮，對社區凝聚力有什麼正面影響？
lv3: 舉辦大型國際體育賽事對主辦城市在經濟、環境及社會層面各有什麼利與弊？請從三方面分析。
香港運動員在國際賽事取得佳績，對香港形象和市民身份認同有何影響？政府應如何更有效地支持本地體育發展？
